description: A generation for a model that is not an image model is refused.

exceptions.reason: The new core's OpenAI-style error bodies always carry a code; the Codex extension refuses a model that is not an image model with code invalid_request.

The new core serves the Images API through the Codex extension only, so the refusal names only the Codex image models; today's core also names xAI's and configured OpenAI-compatible image models, which the new core does not serve on these routes yet.
exceptions.want: Model gpt-test is not supported on /v1/images/generations or /v1/images/edits. Use gpt-image-1.5, gpt-image-2, gpt-image-2.5-flare, gpt-image-2.5-sunburst, gpt-image-2.5.

exceptions.reason: The new core answers application/json; today's core's gin handler adds a charset to the error it writes itself.

The new core routes an Images request by its model and the account's extension refuses a model that is not an image model, so the reply carries the trace ID of a request that reached an account; today's core refuses it in the handler, before routing.

error.message: Model gpt-test is not supported on /v1/images/generations or /v1/images/edits. Use gpt-image-1.5, gpt-image-2, gpt-image-2.5-flare, gpt-image-2.5-sunburst, gpt-image-2.5, grok-imagine-image, grok-imagine-image-quality, grok-imagine-image-2.0, or a configured openai-compatibility image model.
